clue.text: Start and end of satellite moment's gone

indicators.note: says the moment's letters have left the longer word

parts.note: the setting of the moon, our satellite, is when it goes below the horizon: moonset

explanation.surface: Someone timing a satellite's last pass notes the instant it vanishes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'and' is just a link; 'end of satellite' is MOONSET, and 'moment's gone' removes MO from its front.
explanation.definitionFit: The onset of something is its beginning, so a synonym of start as a noun.

clue.text: Domestic beast, cross linking two top-quality bodies

explanation.definitionFit: The blended name for England's two oldest, most prestigious universities, Oxford and Cambridge.

clue.text: A boy wearing fur, not wanted all year

clue.text: Will's wife would go back at peace to poet

explanation.definitionFit: Ogden Nash was the American writer famous for comic light verse, so an example of a poet.
